Pennant star 21393 is ambiguous. The large dot on the gold line is at about (149,122), but the labelled dot for 'the tip of the torn pennant' sits at about (156,107), off the gold line.

Labels collide: 'the lantern hung at the masthead' overlaps 'the head of the sail, top corner'; 'the stern of the hull' overlaps 'the foot of the sail and the top of the stern post'; 'the keel' label runs into the hull edge.
The 'foot of the sail and top of stern post' label points toward an unconnected stray star near (346,286), not at 19515.
